carla_pose_to_world — DRIVE carla op

• Data kinds: any → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.carla_pose_to_world(transform6) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import carlabridge; carlabridge.carla_pose_to_world(transform6) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("carla_pose_to_world"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

CARLA の [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw] → Fullseye の 4×4(world ← object、右手系: y と yaw の符号が反転)。R_f = M R_c M、t_f = M t_c(M = diag(1, −1, 1))。物体の局所系は x 前・y 左・z 上(driveworld の車と同じ)。
